## 1、**DC05PE04**根据给定的递归函数，编写递归算法

```
#include "allinclude.h"  //DO NOT edit this line
int G(int m, int n) 
{  // Add your code here
    if (m<0||n<0) return -1;
    if (m==0&&n>=0) return 0;
    return G(m-1,2*n)+n;
}
```

## 2、**DC05PE20**将给定点元素同色区域的颜色进行置换

```
#include "allinclude.h"  //DO NOT edit this line
void ChangeColor(GTYPE g, int m, int n, char c, int i0, int j0) 
{  // Add your code here
    if (i0>m||j0>n||i0<1||j0<1) {
        return;
    }
    char oc=g[i0][j0];
    g[i0][j0]=c;

    if (oc == g[i0][j0+1]) ChangeColor(g,m,n,c,i0,j0+1);
    if (oc == g[i0][j0-1]) ChangeColor(g,m,n,c,i0,j0-1);
    if (oc == g[i0+1][j0]) ChangeColor(g,m,n,c,i0+1,j0);
    if (oc == g[i0-1][j0]) ChangeColor(g,m,n,c,i0-1,j0);

}
```

## 3、**DC05PE30**求广义表的深度

```
#include "allinclude.h"  //DO NOT edit this line
int GListDepth(GList ls) 
{ // Add your code here
 
    if (ls == NULL) {
        return 1;
    }
    
    if (ls->tag == ATOM) {
        return 0;
    }
    
    GList p=ls;
    int max=0;
    while (p!=NULL) {
        int depth_hp = GListDepth(p->un.ptr.hp);
        if (max<depth_hp) {
            max=depth_hp;
        }
        p=p->un.ptr.tp;
    }
    
    
    return  1+max;



}
```

## 4、**DC05PE32**判别两个广义表是否相等

```
#include "allinclude.h"  //DO NOT edit this line
Status Equal(GList A, GList B) 
{  // Add your code here
    if (A==NULL&&B==NULL) {
        return TRUE;
    }else if (A!=NULL&&B!=NULL) {
        
    }else {
        return FALSE;
    }

    if (A->tag!=B->tag) {
        return FALSE;
    }
    if (A->tag==ATOM&&B->tag==ATOM) {
        if (A->un.atom==B->un.atom) {
            return TRUE;
        }else {
            return FALSE;
        }
    }

    GList a=A;
    GList b=B;
    while (a!=NULL&&b!=NULL) {
        bool sign=Equal(a->un.ptr.hp,b->un.ptr.hp);
        if (sign==FALSE) {
            return FALSE;
        }else {
            a=a->un.ptr.tp;
            b=b->un.ptr.tp;
            if ((a==NULL&&b!=NULL)||(b==NULL&&a!=NULL)) {
                return FALSE;
            }
        }
    }
    return  TRUE;

}
```

## 5、**DC05PE33**输出广义表中所有原子项及其所在的层次

```
#include "allinclude.h"  //DO NOT edit this line
void OutAtom(GList A, int layer, void(*Out2)(char, int)) 
{ // Add your code here
if (A==NULL) {
    return;
}
if (A->tag==ATOM) {
    Out2(A->un.atom,layer);
    return;
}

GList p=A;
while (p!=NULL) {
    OutAtom(p->un.ptr.hp,layer+1,Out2);
    p=p->un.ptr.tp;
}
}
```
